what: When the top edge of a number card reaches the center of the screen, the numbers in its cells count up from 0 (or data-from) to their final value over 2s power1.out. While counting they show as integers with decimals dropped. Runs once only

options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or ”0.25,1,0.5,1”, default power1.out
options.round: How it prints while counting — default rounds down (integer), round rounds off, a number gives decimals to that place (1 → 12.3), text keeps the decimal places written in the text per cell (5 and 7.2 on one line)
options.[data-fx-part=num]: Counting number slot — the text is left at the end value. data-to (end value, defaults to the number in the text) · data-from (start value, default 0). If absent, the element itself is the number
options.delay: Seconds to postpone the start, default 0 — attach per cell to strengthen them in turn (Brand 0 · .15 · .3)
options.pad: when on, pads leading zeros to the digit count of the end value while counting (00 → 14) — from a reference site
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: A circle that draws its outline along with the number (svg circle·path) — stroked with stroke-dashoffset in proportion to the number out of max
options.max: Value for one full turn of the circle, default 100
options.group: If on, adds a thousands comma to the integer part while counting (1,380) — Brand

note: If scripts don’t run or reduced motion is on, the end value is shown as is
